title: sharing: a package-declared sharing rule binds no record hooks for an organization created after boot (a fresh environment's first sign-up), so its grants are missing until the next restart
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Filing gate: ① a defect measured by the dev of #36942 (PR #36965, report 7132678645 on #36942, `out_of_scope_findings` class a); filed by the seat (dev agents never file cards). Untriaged: grade, domain and state are triage's. Direction: it under-grants (a declared grant is missing), it does not widen access.

## What happens (measured)

`SharingServicePlugin` binds its per-record rule hooks once, at boot, from `listRules()`. Under a walled posture a declared rule is served once per EXISTING organization. With no organization at boot, nothing is bound for the rule's object, and the organization-created middleware (`addDeclaredRuleScope`) adds the new organization's scope later but binds no hook.

Measured with `sys_task_assignee` (PR #36965's declared rule, `field` recipient on `assignee_id`, edit access), one boot, the organization inserted after `bootstrap()`: the assignee's `findOne` returns null and `sys_record_share` holds no row. Calling `evaluateAllForRecord('sys_task', id, SYSTEM)` by hand writes the edit grant (`grantsCreated 1`) and the read then succeeds. Control: a second boot over the same database, organization present at boot — every case passes.

## Who reaches it

Every package-declared sharing rule, in every environment whose first organization is created after the server booted — a fresh environment's first sign-up is the common path — until the next restart.

## Expected

A declared sharing rule's record hooks serve an organization created after boot exactly as one present at boot, without a restart.

## Pointers

`SharingServicePlugin` (rule-hook binding at boot, `addDeclaredRuleScope`), `evaluateAllForRecord`. PR #36965's runtime test `task-note-objects-36942.test.ts` boots twice over one sqlite file because of this.

Dedupe: `declared sharing rule`, `rule hooks bound at boot`, `organization created after boot`, `addDeclaredRuleScope`, `field recipient grant missing` — no open card found.
